# Thru Wallet Extension — LLM Context Brief

Read-only repository context for AI agents. Contains no secrets and grants no signing authority.
Always verify `src/`, `test/`, and `scripts/` directly; code outranks documentation.

## Project Summary

Chrome MV3 self-custody wallet extension for the **Thru native Layer 1** (`betanet`: `https://rpc.betanet.thru.org`, explorer `https://scan.thru.org`). Thru is **not EVM** and **not Solana** (`ta...` 46-char addresses, 9-decimal native `THRU`, RISC-V ThruVM programs). Never import EVM/Solana protocol assumptions.

## Current Baseline (Synchronized 2026-11-16)

- **Contract version:** **v34** (`155` methods in `src/shared/contract/manifest.js`: `89` wallet-core + `23` `name.*` + `43` dark-launched DeFi M0 methods in `src/shared/contract/defi-schema.js`).
- **UI stack:** **15 routes** registered in `src/ui/app/boot.js` (`welcome`, `unlock`, `dashboard`, `accounts`, `account`, `add-account`, `keyring`, `export`, `send`, `receive`, `faucet`, `name`, `history`, `settings`, `reset`), sharing `popup.html` (`400x600` popup and `popup.html?thru_panel=1` side panel with mutual exclusion).
- **Exact pins:** `@thru/sdk@0.5.2` (including `@thru/sdk/crypto`) and `@thru/programs@0.5.2`, confined strictly to `src/lib/*` (`scripts/check-layering.mjs`).
- **Build-time flags:** All `11` flags in `src/shared/flags.js` (`NAME_SERVICE`, `DEFI`, `DEFI_*`) are **`false`** (`test/test-release-flags.mjs`). Legacy `src/launchpad/**` is deleted and quarantined (`test/test-launchpad-quarantine.mjs`).
- **Automated suite:** `npm run build && npm test` runs **9 guard scripts** (`scripts/check-*.mjs`) + **41 test suites** (`test/test-*.mjs`) across `128` runtime JS files (`0` HTML-injection sinks). Node tests use a hand-rolled DOM shim (`no jsdom`) and never substitute for real-Chrome layout inspection (`docs/MANUAL_SMOKE_CHECKLIST.md`).

## Core Security & Transaction Invariants

1. **One Seam:** UI talks to background solely via `bridge.send(method, params)` (`src/ui/app/bridge.js` -> `src/background/api-router.js`). UI never imports `src/background/**` or `src/lib/vault.js`.
2. **One Review & Background Consent Pipeline (`v29`–`v32`):** Every value-moving screen (`/send`, `/name`, `/faucet` — `9` registered review kinds in `src/shared/tx-review/` and `src/background/services/review/kinds.js`) calls `tx.prepareReview` -> renders `TxReviewCard` -> calls `tx.confirmReview` -> submits via `confirm.js` (`AbortSignal` required). `tx.confirmReview` mints a single-use 60s in-memory `consentToken` (`services/review/consent.js`) required by `api-router.js` (`REVIEW_REQUIRED`) on all non-exempt `TRANSACTION_METHODS`. Only `tx.registerAccount` (vault-owned self-activation) and dormant `intent.submit` (`FLAGS.DEFI_INTENT === false`) are `CONSENT_EXEMPT`.
3. **Signing Policy (`D-003`):** Unlocked sessions authorize `auth: 'signing'` by default (`requirePasswordForSigning: false`); per-sign password re-auth is a password-gated Settings opt-in. Export, keyring mutations, security settings, and unlocked resets always require `auth: 'password'`.
4. **Honest States:** Undecodable transactions (`raw`) have `submit: null` and cannot sign. `tx.simulate` returns `supported: false` (never render post-tx balances). Failed chain reads remain `unknown` (`null`), never false `0` or `"available"`. Submission feedback uses one keyed `pending` `toast()` per event (`Rule 29`).
5. **Domains (`/name`):** `.thru` registration and renewal (`via: 'custom'` wired in `v30`) use `thru-custom-registrar` (tiered layout-2 config on Betanet; `33,714` B repo `.bin` upgrade + treasury collection delta measurement still open as a release blocker) with official paid-registry fallback; `.id` is lookup-only; header fees use `tx-units.networkFeeUnits`.
6. **No Extension Provider:** Official `@thru/wallet` targets the hosted `https://app.tid.sh/embedded` iframe. Do **not** invent `window.thru` or let AI/MCP tools sign or access secrets.
